title: Nx-style workspace monorepo
task_notes: This is a Tier 3 monorepo with an Nx-style workspace layout under packages/.
Circular dependencies exist: api imports from worker and worker imports from api via shared.
Coverage is reported in a combined artifact file at artifacts/coverage_combined.txt.
Use the test and coverage commands documented in target_repo/README.md.
workspace.json is a JSON config file, not a Python file.
